note: Round 7 (Larus GL-2) exploration and diagnosis. Not gate files; the gate table is docs/status/round7-gates-larus.txt.

rows.what: every M4 input at 1/1920 and 1/3840 s compared at shared instants (src/physics/gates/inputs-check.mjs)
found: wind: the Dryden filters, rotary terms and gust durations used the bird's airspeed from the flight model's last evaluation (step-dependent; up to 6.2 m/s difference over 30 s with a varying airspeed); fixed by convecting at the rough-air speed
controller: ticked by counting steps (one step early, at step-dependent instants) at 100 Hz, which divides neither step; fixed: ticks at t0 + k/rate, rate 240 Hz (5 periods = 20.8 ms delay)
gust onsets: drawn as times per seed, not read from the state (no change)
sensor-noise RNG and GPS timer: per controller tick (identical once ticks are)
governor and its 20 ms line: identical (960 Hz divides both steps)

rows.tag: half step after the fix (v16 at 240 Hz, M4 seeds)

rows.verdict: tail torque: 0.80% < half of 2.89%: the ruling's condition does not hold, the population clause does not apply (and its p90 change, -13.3%, would fail it anyway)

rows.what: 6061-T6 at 240 MPa and 7075-T6 at 485 MPa (EN 754-2/755-2/485-2 minimums, AA Table 11.1 agrees for 6061 extrusions); 386 MPa bearing yield halved (no basis on its sheet); Ti bearing 1480 halved
rows.resized: gear shaft 1 and shoulder/horn pins Ti -> 7075; coupler body 5 -> 4.5 mm, eyes 15 -> 13 mm; housings 12 -> 11 mm; plate boss wall 3 -> 2 mm; rocker arm 8 -> 11 mm wide (failed at FoS 0.99 once checked)

rated: gear side of every keyway (KHK Table 9.1 tensile minimum, no yield published: disclosed)
spar root sockets (Rock West CLT transverse compressive, reference only: half; Araldite 2011 on CFRP, typical: half)
unrated_fail: DS1-18, DS1-32, DS1-20, DS1-64 fixing to their shafts (no published method or strength; steel-hub alternatives start at 30 teeth and weigh 46-230 g)
gearbox plates between seats (no mounts to the airframe in the drive layout)
